name: Meesho Ltd.
business_summary: Zero-commission value e-commerce marketplace for tier-2+ India with in-house logistics (Valmo) and growing ad monetisation. Listed Dec 2025; price Rs 235.7 (+26.6% in 3m), 1y vol 54%. Q2 FY27: loss narrowed ~68%, marketplace revenue +34% to Rs 4,120 cr; content commerce NMV +152% (Upstox, 6 Oct); festive orders +75% on day 1. Acquired Kirana Club for Rs 202 cr (June 2026). Screener dossier not retrievable; fundamentals are headline-only.

exposures.mechanism: Meesho's buyers are mostly tier-2+ and value-seeking; +5pp rural/semi-urban demand growth -> orders +4% -> revenue +4% (take rate ~10-12% on ads/fees); contribution margin ~5% of GOV with 60% incremental -> EBITDA swings large from low base -> +4 after persistence 0.5 and growth-multiple.

evidence.note: Q2 loss narrowed 68% (Storyboard18 3 Nov); marketplace revenue +34% to Rs4,120 cr (Exchange4Media); shares +2% (Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: Smaller share of buyers; +5pp urban demand -> +0.8% orders -> ~+1.5 with growth multiple.
Apparel/value goods dominate GMV; GST cut -> lower prices -> order volume +2% and conversion; 'festive sale orders +75% on Day 1' (Upstox 11 Oct). Net +3 incl. sentiment; persistence 0.3.

Logistics (Valmo + 3PL) is ~45% of costs (model knowledge) and fuel ~20% of logistics cost; +10% Brent -> logistics +1% -> ~+0.4% of revenue; with EBITDA near breakeven/early profit the equity effect is -1 (persistence 0.3, higher on growth-multiple).

evidence.note: Q2 loss narrowed 68% (Storyboard18 3 Nov); marketplace revenue +34% to Rs4,120 cr (Exchange4Media); shares +2% (Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: Gig/platform-worker contributions and logistics-partner costs rise under labour codes; 0.3% of GOV on ~8% net take rate = EBITDA -5% of potential steady-state margin; -1.5 after pass-through.
Loss-making/early-profit platform with ~1.0 lakh cr market cap (price Rs 236 x ~450 cr shares, model knowledge): duration ~35y; +25bp -> -3.
Recent listing (Dec 2025), possible MSCI inclusion (NDTV Profit 6 Oct), and block deals (23 Sep, Rs 900 cr) make flows a key price driver.

evidence.note: Stock jumps 6% on potential MSCI inclusion

exposures.mechanism: 54% annualised vol; +5 VIX points -> -4 after market component.
Apparel price inflation lowers affordability; sellers pass cotton price rises through; +10% cotton -> apparel price +1% -> orders -0.5% -> -0.4.
